premium_access.details: The yearly plan (Premium) includes a 7-day free trial for eligible customers. Monthly and Lifetime have no trial. The paywall appears at the end of first-launch onboarding. Alternate paths: Journal > See every morning when older history is locked, or Alarm settings > unlimited follow-ups.

criteria_evidence.evidence: devpost-submission.md describes the morning-question camera overlay, AlarmKit stop-intent follow-ups subject to plan and settings, on-device transcription, and evening reflection. Implementations: Features/MorningQuestion, Utils/StopAlarmIntent.swift, and Features/NightReflection. This is implementation evidence, not a claim that the system stop UI is unbypassable.

devpost-submission.md connects the dark palette, warm dots, recording haptics, and serif Seven Mornings share card to the quiet visual direction. Shared/MorningDotsPhysicsView.swift implements SpriteKit physics and CoreMotion tilt; Features/SevenMornings implements the share card. PR #120 records the dots/calendar redesign.

Not yet evidenced. devpost-submission.md explicitly records that no verified Noise campaign, viral-post URL, or attributable results are available. The secondary award is conditional on Noise participation and real evidence; implemented sharing alone does not establish virality.

Features/ShareCard/AnswerShareCardPage.swift and Features/SevenMornings/SevenMorningsShareCardView.swift render reusable single-answer and seven-answer images. SevenMorningsPage.swift exports with ShareLink. devpost-submission.md distinguishes implemented repeatability from unmeasured distribution at scale.

The Seven Mornings card includes the question, dated answers, and app name. devpost-submission.md explains the intended connection between that image and the journal concept while explicitly stating that conversion to downloads is unmeasured.
